Method of Attack: Used a Mirai-based botnet to spread aggressively and enlist systems into DDoS (distributed denial of service) swarms
Exploits a critical command injection vulnerability (CVE-2021-36260) in Hikvision cameras
Attack Vector: Command injection vulnerability via specially crafted messages sent to vulnerable Hikvision web servers
Indicators of Compromise: Vulnerable Hikvision cameras located mostly in China, United States, Vietnam, UK, Ukraine, Thailand, South Africa, France, Netherlands, Romania
Lists of credentials for Hikvision camera live video feeds on clearnet hacking forums
